name: io.github.priors-agents/priors
title: Priors
description: Pay x402 APIs in USDG on Robinhood Chain, borrow and repay a Priors credit line, check records.

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated agent wallet on Robinhood Chain; without it (or PRIORS_KEY_FILE) only the read-only tools work

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path (or ~/) of a file holding the agent wallet's key, read only when nobody but the user can read it; instead of PRIORS_KEY

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The wallet's Priors (ERC-8004) agent id, when it cannot be looked up

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_MAX_PRICE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Most one x402 call may cost (default 1.00)

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_MAX_SPEND_USD
environmentVariables.description: Most x402 payments may total while the server runs (default 5)

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_MAX_SPEND_DAY_USD
environmentVariables.description: Most x402 payments may total per UTC day for the agent, across restarts (needs PRIORS_AGENT_ID)

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_MAX_BORROW_DAY_USD
environmentVariables.description: Most the agent may borrow per UTC day, across restarts (needs PRIORS_AGENT_ID; 0 turns borrowing off)

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_PAY_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated exact hosts pay_url may pay; any other URL is refused before a request

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_JOIN
environmentVariables.description: on: join (registers an ERC-8004 identity for this wallet when it owns none) and first_line (the treasury's first line for it, with PRIORS_BOT_URL); off by default

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_LINE_BOARD
environmentVariables.description: on: the line board, signed by this wallet: line_ask and line_take for an agent it owns, and line_offer, line_send and line_back_own for a root it owns; off by default

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_MAX_BACK_DAY_USD
environmentVariables.description: Most line line_send and line_back_own may send from this wallet per UTC day, across restarts (read only with PRIORS_LINE_BOARD=on; none by default; 0 sends none)

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_STRATEGIES
environmentVariables.description: on: strategies_list and strategy_read, read only: the trading strategies published on Priors' strategy board; off by default

environmentVariables.name: PRIORS_STRATEGIES_URL
environmentVariables.description: The strategy board read with PRIORS_STRATEGIES=on (default https://test.priors.trade/api/strategies); https, or http for localhost only
